title: edgeR Differential Expression Analysis — edgeR_diffexp
text: Performs differential expression analysis formatted DESeq2 object. INPUTS: DESeq2 object metadata columns corresponding samples supplied. condition: string giving name condition column within DESeq2 object's @colData metadata. reference_group_name: string specifying control group experiment. OUTPUTS: list data frames containing possible combination binary comparisons (control vs. experimental group) within supplied metadata. resulting data frames contain following columns: log2FC: log2-scaled fold change given gene across specified samples. P-value: probability obtaining data extreme observed values assuming null hypothesis true. Q-value (FDR): proportion false positives accounting multiple testing.
